description: Budget for Zig tests that skip themselves, read by scripts/check-test-skips.ps1 (PKG-76, F207). allowedSkips lists the tests in the guarded family that may skip on that runner; a skip outside it fails, because a shaping or metrics test that stops running looks like green CI. maxTotalSkipped is the total across the whole suite. Lower a number when a skip goes away. Raise one only with the reason in the commit message.

windows-2022.comment: 2026-10-17: 77 measured in Server 2022 run 39076551334. The added skip is config.windows_shell.test.shell discovery accepts a real installed Store execution alias (#443): it requires a usable installed wt.exe or winget.exe Store alias. This optional installed-alias coverage is unavailable on this runner; it is not an explicit build-number gate. The nine font skips are unchanged. 2026-11-06: 80 measured in Server 2022 run 42269314099. The three added since run 40796984718 (77 on 2026-10-29) came with #638 and #635 on 2026-10-31 and skip by design, never seen here before because the suite failed first from 2026-11-02: os.local_path.test.link target: no text in the full sweep aborts or leaks (runs only with NOCTTY_RUN_LOCAL_PATH_SWEEP=1); terminal.kitty.graphics_image.test.image load: windows file path that is not drive-absolute is refused (needs the temporary directory on the current directory's drive, and the runner checks out on D:); terminal.search.pattern.test.forQuery rejects non-default options without oniguruma (the build has oniguruma). 2026-11-22: 81 with the 1A merge of upstream Ghostty 1.4.0 (stone-1a). The one added skip is terminal.compress.lz4_differential.test.lz4 differential exhaustive, from upstream 9a4bd2120: it runs only with GHOSTTY_LZ4_SLOW set, so it skips by design. Measured in windows10-branches run 45015465523 at 60f222ee7 (81 against 80; the skip names differ from main's last passing run 43812228310 by that test alone). The nine font skips are unchanged.
